name: adam-agentskills
description: Adam Daniel's reusable agent skills, packaged as Claude Code plugins grouped by audience (coding or not) and runtime (anywhere or local).

plugins.name: adam-anything-anywhere
plugins.description: Adam's skills for any Claude surface, coding or not: the claude.ai web and iOS apps, Claude in Chrome, the Claude Desktop app, and Claude Code. Writing ADRs and resolving task ambiguity.

plugins.name: adam-coding-anywhere
plugins.description: Adam's coding skills for Claude Code terminals and Claude Code cloud sessions: GitHub Actions debugging and hardening, settings-as-code, bash CI reliability review, skill provenance, and disarming inherited reach.

plugins.name: adam-coding-local
plugins.description: Adam's machine-bound coding skills for Claude Code on the owner's own machines (WSL and Windows homes): skill sync, Claude Code settings, session and memory management, and elevation from WSL.

plugins.name: adam-non-coding-local
plugins.description: Adam's non-coding skills that need local files or a signed-in browser, for the Claude Desktop app's local Cowork: PDF OCR, audit, renaming and comparison, and Fastmail email and sending-identity workflows.

plugins.name: cms-platform
plugins.description: The cms-platform site machinery's own skills, federated from that repo rather than mirrored here: Decap /admin config rendering, AWS bootstrap and PR preview environments, Playwright e2e, CI watcher loops, stuck-PR triage, and the platform release/consumer-bump flow.
